A heartfelt thank you to the Il Mio Gatto ed Io Veterinary Clinic. ❤️

Our Blur was lost in France, and for a week we lived with anxiety and fear of never being able to find him. Unexpectedly, we were contacted by the clinic, which immediately took action to help us and put us in touch with a veterinarian in France.

Their helpfulness and kindness were truly special. We weren't expected to be so interested in our situation, and yet they gave us real help just when we needed it most.

Fortunately, thanks in part to this collaboration, we were able to find our Blur and bring him home. 🐱❤️

Thank you so much for what you did for us. You were fantastic, and we will never forget it.

First of all, the facility is just as pictured, very well-maintained and immediately conveys the feeling of a calm, tailor-made environment for both cats and owners—in other words, that we're in the right place. Ultimately, we feel confident that the path we've taken is the right one and that we're in the hands of qualified and competent professionals. ❤️

A truly special veterinarian, especially for those who deeply love their cats. She welcomed me when many others were closed, with great availability and professionalism. The office is wonderful: immaculately clean, well-maintained, almost a boutique dedicated to felines, with everything needed readily available, including many very useful medications without having to rush elsewhere. But what struck me most is her approach: she doesn't limit herself to treating the symptom, but seeks to understand the underlying cause, asking questions about ethology, environment, stress, habits, and the cat's behavior. A rare attention, which makes you feel truly listened to and understood. Thank you so much for your expertise, sensitivity, and genuine love for felines🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍

I almost never write reviews, but this time I really feel the need to...
I discovered the "Il mio gatto e io" clinic almost by chance, at a time when I was quite worried and a little discouraged. My cat, Neko, is going through a difficult time: after a urinary obstruction, we had to introduce a specific diet, which unfortunately caused digestive problems. Anyone who owns a cat knows how difficult it can be to manage situations like this, and unfortunately, it's not always easy to find veterinarians who truly have the time and sensitivity to carefully follow these procedures.
When I entered the clinic, I was immediately amazed. It doesn't even feel like a veterinary clinic: the waiting room is beautiful, meticulously detailed, artistic, and welcoming. It's almost like entering an elegant and peaceful loft. There's a serene atmosphere that immediately puts both people and cats at ease, which is anything but a given.
The examination room is also splendid: bright, well-maintained, and truly designed with the animals' well-being in mind. I walked in, literally speechless.
But what struck me most was the human and professional quality of the time dedicated to us. Domitilla and Marta were incredibly sweet and attentive. Marta, in particular, guided the entire visit with extraordinary sensitivity: she let Neko play, made him feel comfortable, cuddled him, and observed him with great calm and attention. They dedicated an hour and a half to him, something truly rare these days.
Going to the vet has always been stressful for Neko, but here something surprising happened: he was calm, curious, even engaged in play. It was a completely different experience from what we were used to.
I myself finally felt listened to, welcomed, and supported. After weeks of worry, I left with a great sense of relief and the certainty of having found competent, empathetic professionals who deeply care about the well-being of cats.
I know that from now on I will always trust them.
I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone who has a cat and wants not only high-quality veterinary care but also a respectful, peaceful, and truly feline-friendly environment.

In the attached photo, I've attached Neko with the catnip toy Marta gave him (he loves it!) and Neko in love with the sink.
Thank you so much, Domitilla and Marta, we'll talk soon! 😺

Chiara and Domitilla are fantastic, caring, and competent. I'm so happy to have found this clinic, the first and only one of its kind in Rome. They were the first to know how to handle Lucius, a difficult cat, and they're also very good at guiding us cat companions through anxieties, doubts, and advice for feline well-being.

I'll add here, since I haven't figured out how to write a second review (!): we met Arianna, a new addition to the team, and she was invaluable for her availability, professionalism, feline love, and kindness. The clinic confirms its excellence in every way. I hope this review can help all those struggling cat lovers who, like me, were initially lost in their search for a place to look after their pet's health. Cats are mysterious beings with fascinating psychology and are often misunderstood or equated with dogs, but at this clinic, they know how to handle them, there's genuine passion and, above all, a great deal of empathy for the owner and their furry companion.
Professional, kind, helpful, and always smiling. Thank you!
